exposure: postplacental intrauterine device (IUD) placement at cesarean delivery
outcome: characteristics associated with postplacental IUD use
perioperative morbidity (leukocytosis, endometritis, myometritis, and sepsis)
cohort: 2,983,978 patients who underwent cesarean delivery from October 2015 to December 2018 in the United States, excluding those with hemorrhage, chorioamnionitis, uterine anomaly, hysterectomy, and permanent surgical sterilization
finding: The use of postplacental IUD at cesarean delivery significantly increased in the United States from 2015 to 2018, and this practice was not associated with an increased risk of measured perioperative morbidity.
